Auth.name: Full name

Entity.title: Cloud computing
Entity.cloudQuestion: Does the entity use, or plan to use, cloud computing or hosting services?
Entity.cloudHelp: Subdomain 4-2 controls (Cloud Computing and Hosting Cybersecurity) apply only to entities that use or plan to use these services. Answering “No” makes its four controls not applicable.
Entity.yesLong: Yes, it uses or plans to use them
Entity.savedNo: Answer saved. Subdomain 4-2 controls are now not applicable.
